recognize_zh: 這是間期 FISH 的示意圖（非型態圖）：藍色 DAPI 染色的細胞核內出現三個洋紅色探針訊號，代表該染色體區域多一份拷貝；在 CLL 的標準 FISH 組合中，這種模式即為 12 號染色體三體（trisomy 12）。
features: Schematic interphase FISH illustration rather than a photographed cell
Three discrete magenta signals from one probe within the nucleus
Three copies of a single-locus or centromeric probe indicate a trisomy (normal = two signals)
No second-color control probe is shown
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic schematic of interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization. A single DAPI-counterstained nucleus contains three magenta signals from one probe, whereas a normal diploid nucleus would show two. In the chronic lymphocytic leukemia FISH panel (13q14, 11q22/ATM, 17p13/TP53, centromere 12), three signals with the chromosome 12 centromeric probe indicate trisomy 12, which carries intermediate prognosis and is associated with atypical morphology and CD38 expression. Interpretation requires scoring many nuclei against a laboratory cutoff.
